tasks.title: Conversation #60
tasks.transcript:
Man: Did you go to the rock concert in the park yesterday afternoon?
Woman: I went to a gardening workshop at the University Center instead. It's sad that I missed out on the concert, but I'm starting my own garden and I need to know all the insurance and outs of growing herbs and vegetables.
Man: Nice. And to be honest, you didn't miss that much,
Woman: no?
Man: Well, I love some of the songs they played, but the acoustics in the park aren't very good, so the sound quality was rather mediocre and didn't do justice to the songs.

questions.stem: Why does the woman mention her new garden?

options.A: To offer the man some herbs and vegetables
options.B: To imply that the man should visit the university center
options.C: To indicate that she cannot go to the park tomorrow afternoon
options.D: To explain why attending a workshop was important for her

questions.analysis: 答案: D 题目问的是: 为什么女人提到她的新花园？ 定位原文: “I'm starting my own garden and I need to know all the ins and outs of growing herbs and vegetables.” 选项分析: A. “To offer the man some herbs and vegetables.”（给男人一些草药和蔬菜。）她并没有提到要送给男人这些东西，因此A选项错误。 B. “To imply that the man should visit the university center.”（暗示男人应该去大学中心。）她提到花园是为了说明自己参加工作坊的原因，而不是邀请男人去大学中心，因此B选项错误。 C. “To indicate that she cannot go to the park tomorrow afternoon.”（表明她明天下午不能去公园。）这与她提到花园的原因无关，因此C选项错误。 D. “To explain why attending a workshop was important for her.”（解释为什么参加工作坊对她来说很重要。）她提到花园是为了阐明自己需要了解种植草药和蔬菜的知识，这就是为什么参加工作坊对她来说重要，因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: What does the man imply about the rock concert?

options.C: It did not include the man's favorite songs.
options.D: It was held at an unsuitable location.

questions.analysis: 答案: D 题目问的是: 男人对摇滚音乐会有什么看法？ 定位原文: “Well, I love some of the songs they played, but the acoustics in the park aren't very good, so the sound quality was rather mediocre and didn't do justice to the songs.” 选项分析: A. “It was highly enjoyable.”（它非常好玩。）男人并没有说音乐会很享受，而是指出音质不好，因此A选项错误。 B. “It featured mostly mediocre musicians.”（它主要有一些平庸的音乐家。）他并没有评论音乐家，而是提到音质问题，因此B选项错误。 C. “It did not include the man's favorite songs.”（它没有包括男人最喜欢的歌曲。）他提到了一些自己喜欢的歌曲，因此C选项错误。 D. “It was held at an unsuitable location.”（它举行的地点不合适。）他提到的是公园里的音质问题，所以暗示了地点不合适，因此D选项正确。
